findings.title: The page sells a week on the canal but shows no boat or water

location.description: the whole page; on desktop and widescreen the empty band below the content

findings.viewer_experience: The visitor is booking a week on a canal but sees only text and form fields, so the copy has to carry the whole feeling of the trip.

current.value: no boat, lock or canal at any viewport; about 190 px of empty space under the content on desktop and about 470 px on widescreen

findings.target: one specific photo of this company's boats or a route, sized so the form stays where it is
findings.fix_direction: Add one photo of the company's boats or a route, in the empty band where there is room. The maker must supply the photo.

closed_when.check: A fresh critic sees a real photo of a boat or the canal on the page, and the form is still where it was.

findings.title: The start date shows no year

location.description: the Start date field in the search card

findings.viewer_experience: The field shows "Sat 14 June" with no year and no sign of a date picker, so the visitor cannot tell which June they are booking.

current.value: "Sat 14 June", no year, no calendar icon

findings.target: the year shown in the field, or a calendar icon beside it
findings.fix_direction: Show the year in the date, or add a calendar icon.

closed_when.check: In the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen images the Start date field shows a year or a calendar icon.

findings.title: The routes list on tablet is narrower than the card and nav above it

location.description: the routes list at the bottom of the tablet page

findings.viewer_experience: The rules of the routes list end at x 688 while the form card and nav above end at x 720, so the right edges do not line up.

current.value: list rules end at x 688; card and nav end at x 720

findings.target: routes list as wide as the card, right edges aligned
findings.fix_direction: Make the routes list as wide as the form card so the right edges line up.

closed_when.check: In the tablet image the right edge of the routes list rules lines up with the right edge of the form card.
